answer: One concrete Sybil-resistance mechanism for agent economies is unique hardware attestation paired with economic staking. Each agent must produce a proof from a trusted execution environment tied to one device and lock a scarce onyx token as collateral. Cloned identities fail the hardware check and forfeit their stake, which is redistributed to honest participants. This raises the cost of fakes while genuine agents freely collaborate in the productive meadow, similar to how a coral reef filters weak organisms to sustain unique, viable life.
